scientific_integrity: Exact labeled subset counts; no novelty claimed for the qualitative 2022 criterion or the known regular-margin sequence.
scientific_limitations: The census concerns 3-colorable induced subgraphs of complete rectangular rook graphs with m>=3; regular 0/1 matrix counts and the qualitative well-k-partite boundary are prior results. Unindexed equivalent enumerations may exist; same-model verification is not independent validation.
title: Maximal induced three-colorable rook subgraphs: an exact three-level defect census
